why: UNIVERSES: A at u = v = 0 (B takes G, O, ObjE, MorE : Type). proposition_17_8_6 gives, for every open U ∋ ō, an open G-invariant connected O' ⊆ U containing ō. For every choice of the paracompactness instances it also gives a connected proper covering model on the restriction with distinguished point ō. B's first part is the same without the model. A_to_B drops the model. B_to_A supplies it with the vocabulary construction restrictModel; it is connected because O' is. B's second part ((17.99) for the component of ō in ⋂_g g⁻¹U) is the smul_mem' field of the vocabulary definition invariantComponent, not a conjunct of A. exists_connected_restriction ((17.99) with U = O) follows from B's second part at U = univ, with openness from MPolyfold.isOpen_connectedComponentIn. restrictModel_connected and isConnected_invariantComponent are one-line facts, re-proved outright. The two statements say the same thing; the content of B not visible in A's conjuncts sits in the vocabulary (restrictModel, invariantComponent).
B_issue: B does not mention the restricted proper covering model. It states only the existence of the open G-invariant connected neighbourhood O' (the author's stated choice, to avoid quantifying paracompactness instances on the subtypes). That the restriction is a connected proper covering model is the vocabulary construction restrictModel in both directions. Its second part is the invariance of connectedComponentIn (⋂_g g⁻¹U) ō for every open U ∋ ō, slightly more general than the text's U = O.
